speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history involving gait and limb ataxia; to begin our workup, have you experienced any recent changes in your vision, such as double vision or blurred vision?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms of a drunken gait and right-sided clumsiness suggest involvement of your cerebellum or spinal cord. Have you noticed any weakness or numbness in your arms or legs, or any problems with your speech or swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy for Crohn's disease.
